text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Early on in the new year, Admire Vega
and I are
shopping for necessities when...

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Here you are, one bonus raffle ticket!
Thanks for
shopping with us!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...A raffle ticket?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two! You have a ticket! Why
not try
your luck?
choice_data_list: そういうキャンペーン中だったんだな
そういうキャンペーン中だったんだね

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
You could win a trip to a hot spring with

incredible scenery out in the
countryside! The
starry sky will be sure
to help you relax!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In that case...
choice_data_list: （ちょっと心が動かされてるみたいだ……）
（ちょっと心が動かされてるみたい……）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a ticket already. It would be a
shame to
let it go to waste.
choice_data_list: せっかくだしやっていったら？

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's true... It would be a waste.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
All right, ready to give it a try? How
about you
do it together? Spin the
tumbler with all your
heart!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
All right, ready to give it a try? How
about you
do it together? Spin the
tumbler with all your
heart!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Heart?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wait. What does he mean by heart?
choice_data_list: よし、特賞当てような、アヤベ！
よし、特賞当てようね、アヤベ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe and I spin the lottery machine
with extra
oomph!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What? The grand prize? Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks...
choice_data_list: やったな、アヤベ！
やったね、アヤベ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe Admire Vega's in shock? She
stares at the
coupon for some time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When she finally starts to speak...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Here... Can you hold on to it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't really know what I
want to
do.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Do I really want to go? Or am I just... I
don't
know.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
But it's not like seeing a special starry
sky doesn't
interest me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If it gets too close to the expiration
date, you can
use it however you like.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: 大事に、預かっておくよ
大事に、預かっておくね

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: 君が答えを出せる日を待ってる
貴方が答えを出せる日を待ってる

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I end up with the coupon
for a hot
spring vacation until Admire
Vega makes up her
mind.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: First prize...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's still pretty lucky.
choice_data_list: 惜しいっ……！

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It feels heavy... I bet it's filling and tastes
great.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Should we have it tonight?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: あれ？俺がもらう流れになってないか？
あれ？私がもらう流れになってない？

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why wouldn't I?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's true, but...
choice_data_list: 君の券で当てたんだから、君のものだよ
貴方の券で当てたんだから、貴方のものだよ

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't normally eat expensive things
like this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: せっかくだしめいっぱい贅沢してみようか！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before heading back, we pick out some
things in
the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Are you going to act like this the rest
of the
day?
choice_data_list: まずはオードブルでございます

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy a full-course meal with the
hamburger
steak as the main dish.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Carrots... A lot of them...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't even think we could finish them
all
ourselves...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Everyone?
choice_data_list: みんなで山分けするのは？

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! This grated carrot salad sandwich
is
fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's seasoned so well and super
light! I feel
like I could eat a whole
bunch without getting
full!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Would that be okay, though?! I feel like
I've
already had a lot!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'm serving them because I want them
all to be
eaten. You can have as many as
you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I also owe you for those rice balls...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yay! Then I won't hold back!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Spe, be careful you don't choke...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Ayabe. I'll have
some too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This would go great with... coffee. I think
I'll have
one too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Being able to eat with one hand
certainly is more
efficient... the
nutritional balance of the
ingredients is
also on point.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! Indeed, I should have no
problem
recruiting someone to feed me
while I'm in the
middle of my
experiments!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Use your own hands, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wow! They're so colorful! Can I have one
to eat
while I'm reading?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Haha! It's like we've been drawn here by
fate! ☆
Brought together by these
marvelous
sandwiches! ★☆

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I think we invited too many people...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's voice drips with regret,
but
looking at her face, she doesn't
really seem to
mind.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A single carrot...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's not very easy to get. I suppose
this is
better than nothing.
choice_data_list: 特賞じゃなくてごめんな……
特賞じゃなくてごめんね……

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine... It's a decent prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back from the raffle...

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Little Sister)
text_block_list.text: Sob... I'm sorry, Sis...

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Big Sister)
text_block_list.text: You don't have to cry! I forgot too, Aiko!

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Big Sister)
text_block_list.text:
But we can't make curry without a
carrot... What
will Mom do?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Did you say you forgot to buy a
carrot?

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Big Sister)
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... yeah. Our mom asked us to go

shopping.

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Little Sister)
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... It's my fault! I was looking at candy and I forgot to help!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's admirable of you to reflect
on your
mistake.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: As a reward... I'll let you have this carrot.

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Little Sister)
text_block_list.text: Hic... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Big Sister)
text_block_list.text: What?! A-are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes. Here, take it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You two get along well. ...Watch out for
cars on
the way home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega speaks softly as she hands
the
carrot to the two sisters who are still
tightly
holding hands.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Nothing...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well... That happens sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Nothing you can do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's her usual unfazed reaction, but I can
tell that
she's feeling more down than
usual.
